fixed_state_replay.interpretation: Repeated exact state and model calls are bitwise identical on CPU. Ada/H200 saved states are not byte-identical at frame 257; running them through the same CPU path preserves one neighbor-row cutoff difference and yields a 1.406e-4 maximum output difference. This isolates sensitivity to state/input divergence but is not a GPU attribution.

inputs.feature_rule: frozen core_models.node_features: float64 source arithmetic then public float32 cast, 23 columns
inputs.neighbor_rule: frozen core_models.neighbor_table: radius 2h, limit 64, squared distance then particle_id then zone

interpretation.not_proven: The posthoc H5 reconstruction cannot identify the first GPU kernel/operator or distinguish which prior layer produced the initial state difference. It cannot attribute the original difference solely to cKDTree or to feature casting.
interpretation.protocol_preserved: No model source, neighbor threshold/order, checkpoint, tolerance, formal ledger, or GPU job was changed.
interpretation.supported: A common 1e-16-scale state difference appears before any neighbor-table difference. Public float32 features differ at frame 1. A distance/ID cutoff ordering swap appears at frame 255 and a 64th-neighbor membership swap at frame 257; the first velocity tolerance failure is frame 284. The observed sequence is consistent with small cross-architecture arithmetic differences amplified until a near-tied distance crosses the fixed 64-neighbor cutoff.

method.dtype: State float64; feature output float32; neighbor indices int64
method.known_inputs: bundle known inputs only; no future CFD/reference states supplied to node_features or neighbor_table
method.prewindow_neighbor_screen: fast cKDTree k=65 stable distance+ID screen on every frame 0..249; exact core_models table rechecked densely on 250..286
method.state_identity: particle_id/zone/mass/valid read from immutable rollout axes; predicted position/velocity read one frame at a time

next_diagnostic.diagnostic_outputs: At each state capture normalized feature hash, encoder output, layer0/1 aggregate, head output, and pre/post prior arrays; record dtype and max elementwise abs/relative error. Do not run a trajectory or alter the production neighbor rule.
next_diagnostic.goal: separate upstream model arithmetic from causal input construction without another 835-step run
next_diagnostic.inputs: Use exact saved Ada state arrays at frames 250,255,257,284 (and exact H200 copies as a second fixture); run both hosts with the same state bytes, same checkpoint/bundle, and capture feature array hash, neighbor array hash, 64th/65th candidate IDs and squared distances.
next_diagnostic.name: fixed_state_input_and_cutoff_replay.v1
next_diagnostic.pass_conditions: With identical state bytes, node_features and neighbor_table must be byte-identical; candidate cutoff ordering must match ID tie rule. Any GPU model mismatch then belongs to model arithmetic, not state/neighbor construction.
next_diagnostic.stability_option: If production cross-architecture reproducibility is required after the replay, evaluate a separately versioned fixed-arithmetic execution path (for example CPU or explicitly controlled matmul) on this short fixture first. Do not quantize distances, widen tolerances, or replace distance+ID ordering in the registered model.

scope.purpose: posthoc CPU reconstruction of causal features and full-field neighbor table from completed paired float64 trajectories
